name: Fantasizing
overview: Scripture warns against indulging in lustful fantasies, revealing that even looking with lust is equivalent to committing adultery in the heart, as Jesus teaches in Matthew 5:28. Proverbs cautions believers not to desire beauty in their hearts or pursue vain persons, emphasizing the spiritual and practical consequences of such inward sins. The works of the flesh, including adultery and uncleanness, are clearly identified as manifestations of sinful human nature in Galatians 5:19, while Galatians 6:3 reminds us of the danger of self-deception when we overestimate our righteousness. Together, these passages call believers to guard their hearts and minds, pursuing holiness as commanded by the LORD.
